choices_in_code.bootstrap_key_mad: statistic index 2 for M_raw (raw 0 and detrended 1 are in the conditions)
choices_in_code.part_index: the scramble key's part: KUPA copy 0, essay 1; Aalto A (sentences 1-7) 0, B (8-15) 1
choices_in_code.H_gaps: H and C use the permuted gaps directly (v6h rebuilt times by cumsum and took differences again): the draws are v6h's, the values equal within rounding (q within about 1e-15)
choices_in_code.dtw_standardisation: z-scores per set (mean removed, as v6's main standardisation), so the level difference between the two tasks is removed
choices_in_code.paired_resamples: the resamples of the later-named stage (y in x - y)
choices_in_code.five_numbers: the min and max of a five-number summary are single persons' values, as in v6h
choices_in_code.gathered_gaps: gathered's gaps pass through v6f's cumsum and differences, so they equal text's multiset within rounding only (as v6i)
choices_in_code.P5: read in both KUPA directions (copy -> essay and essay -> copy), sentence unit
choices_in_code.main_keys: the main stages are checked against v6i with v6i's keys, then counted again on the same distances with v6j's keys for the record
choices_in_code.middle_block_key: the block is deterministic, so the receiving key [.., 32, .., 4] named in the conditions is not drawn
choices_in_code.weak_m: m counts the rests held by giving tiles of random_half before any move
choices_in_code.scrambled_bootstrap: the five draws share one bootstrap key (stage 12)
